subject: Billing remit and entity consolidation for Aurora Works
messages:
From: Elena Santos <elena.santos@auroraworks.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Aurora Works Finance <finance@auroraworks.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Billing remit and entity consolidation — Aurora Works

Hi Sean,

Quick note from the Aurora side — we closed our asset consolidation last week and are centralizing billing under a new legal entity: Aurora Works Holdings LLC (EU branch). Effective immediately we need invoices and statements routed to the new remit address and VAT registration. Can you update Redwood's billing records to the following?

New remit details:
- Legal name: Aurora Works Holdings LLC (EU Branch)
- Remit-to address: 42 Baltic Way, Suite 2, Dublin, D02 FX34, Ireland
- VAT / Tax ID: IE3456789VA
- Preferred vendor code / SAP: AW-HLD-2027 (we will provide a PO later)

There is one outstanding invoice for services through 2027-03-31 (Invoice #AW-2027-031). We need that reissued to the new entity and updated with the VAT number so our AP team can process payment. I attached: Proof_of_registration_Aurora_Holdings.pdf and EU_VAT_certificate.pdf.

Also, can Redwood accept invoices to be sent to ap@auroraworks.com and to our shared SAP vendor code? Our accounts payable would like to align payment terms to net-45 across the consolidated legal entity — is that something we can discuss?

Thanks — copying our finance lead for visibility.

Best,
Elena Santos
Head of Finance, Aurora Works
elena.santos@auroraworks.com
Attachments: Proof_of_registration_Aurora_Holdings.pdf (pdf), EU_VAT_certificate.pdf (pdf)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Santos <elena.santos@auroraworks.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-04-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing remit and entity consolidation — Aurora Works

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the consolidation.

We can update our billing records and reissue the March invoice once we have a couple of items from your side so our finance system and legal team are aligned:
- A signed remittance/authorization letter (company letterhead) or DocuSign authorization confirming Aurora Works Holdings LLC as the remit entity for Redwood invoices.
- Confirmation of the PO or SAP vendor code you want us to stamp on the reissued invoice (AW-HLD-2027 looks fine; please confirm).
- Clarify whether AP should receive invoices at ap@auroraworks.com (we'll add that to the delivery list).

Payment terms: net-45 is a commercial change that needs finance approval. If you can share the DocuSign link and the PO, I'll loop in Laura (billing) and Marissa (account lead) to expedite re-issuance and the net-45 request.

I will place a hold on automatic collections for the March invoice while this is reconciled.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood-inference.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

Hi Sean — thanks, attaching the signed remittance authorization via DocuSign (Signed_remittance_letter_DocuSign.pdf). PO / vendor confirmation below:

- Confirmed SAP vendor code: AW-HLD-2027
- AP email: ap@auroraworks.com
- We will reconcile any tax difference on our side, but please include the VAT number on the reissued invoice.
- DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/id/EXAMPLE-DOCUSIGN-12345 (signature completed by CFO)

On the payment terms: we are requesting net-45 for the consolidated entity. If full net-45 is not acceptable, can Redwood provide a short-term waiver for the March invoice while we complete the vendor onboarding?

Thanks for holding collections while this is sorted.

Best,
Elena

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Santos <elena.santos@auroraworks.com>, sean_gallagher@redwood-inference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-04-17T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing remit and entity consolidation — Aurora Works

Elena / Sean — Laura from Billing Ops here. Quick update: we completed the entity update in our accounting system this morning. Actions taken: 

- Billing entity changed to: Aurora Works Holdings LLC (EU Branch)
- VAT number IE3456789VA added to the customer record
- AP delivery addresses updated to include ap@auroraworks.com and finance@auroraworks.com
- Reissued invoice: 2027-03-31_Remit_Aurora_Holdings.pdf (Invoice #AW-2027-031-R1) — attached.

Notes / next steps:
- We reissued the invoice with the VAT number and the SAP vendor code AW-HLD-2027, but our system requires a formal PO number before we can post the invoice for net-45 credit terms. Please send the PO or confirm the internal PO number so Marissa or Sean can record it.
- We have placed the March invoice on hold for collections until we receive the PO and confirmation of payment terms. If Aurora provides written PO confirmation before 2027-04-30 we will process net-45 for that invoice on a case-by-case basis (finance approval required).
- Attached is the reissued invoice stub and a short summary of tax handling for EU customers (tax_handling_notice.txt). If your AP needs a VAT reverse-charge note instead, let me know and we will include the specific language.

Elena — please confirm the PO and whether net-45 should be applied. Once we have that, we'll mark the invoice for processing and remove the hold.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Manager, Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com
Attachments: 2027-03-31_Remit_Aurora_Holdings.pdf (pdf), tax_handling_notice.txt (txt)
